The Dog Stars Plot : "The movie is set in the aftermath of a catastrophic flu virus that nearly wiped out humanity... the movie follows Hig (Jacob Elordi), a civilian pilot, and a tough ex-marine (Josh Brolin), who face invaders and the hope for a better life outside their current dwelling.

The Dog Stars is scheduled to be released in the United States by 20th Century Studios on August 28, 2026.
